policies.name: internal-export-is-free
policies.code: permit(principal, action == Action::"export", resource) when { context.destination == "internal" };

policies.name: public-data-may-leave
policies.code: permit(principal, action == Action::"export", resource) when { context.destination == "external" && context.classification == "public" };

policies.name: restricted-never-leaves
policies.code: forbid(principal, action == Action::"export", resource) when { context.classification == "restricted" && context.destination == "external" };

tests.name: public data to an external destination allowed
internal export of public data allowed
restricted data leaving the boundary is denied
